paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Junior Auxiliary is collecting winter coats for children and adults through Sunday, Nov. 29. Residents can donate at six locations, and households that need coats can fill out the group’s online request form.

Two First Choice Bank locations are taking donations: the main branch in Pontotoc and the Ecru branch. The other four drop-off sites are Endville Baptist Church, Green Valley Baptist Church, Honey Pies and Ace & Co.

To request a coat, open the Warm Hearts, Warm Coats form linked below. It asks for a household name, email address and phone number. The organizers say they will contact applicants about a collection date after the form is submitted. Nov. 29 is the deadline for donations.
